thread:
nina: quick flag  seeing strange merging of adjacent passages after int8 kernels landed on staging. attribution tests show answers pulling sentence tails from previous chunk.

harry: is this the tokenizer change from yesterday or the new int8 kernel selection?

nina: it correlates with the kernel rollout. tokenizer stayed the same, but token id remapping in the int8 codepath might be shifting pad/sep ids for some tokenizers.

zoe: can you share an example input and the wrong output? we should add a micro-golden and a small dedupe test to the promptset.

nina: minimal repro below (staging):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging-api.internal/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"atlas-int8","input":"[DOC_A]\n...long body...\n[DOC_B]\nquestion: which org published doc B?"}'
```
observed: answer contains publisher from doc A + doc B merged, sometimes duplicates the publisher.

harry: sounds like chunk boundary tokens getting normalized away. two quick mitigation ideas: 1) explicit sentinel <CHUNK_END> inserted between chunks before fingerprinting, 2) normalize unicode whitespace and collapse multiple pads to single standardized pad id in the quant path.

zoe: both. i'll PR chunk sentinel and update the promptset generation pipeline to emit micro-goldens during ingest for any doc pairs that are adjacent in the same original source. also update our dedupe fingerprint to canonicalize contiguous whitespace and remove invisible separators before hash.

labeler-bot: created LB-1230 (50 items) "chunk-boundary-attribution" priority: urgent. reviewers: @labeling-team. due: 36h.

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled: deploy-2026-07-02-sentinel (zoe/chunk-sentinel + harry/quant-pad-fix). ETA 8m.

nina: adding three micro-goldens now: - code-block adjacency - multilingual hyphenation - math-latex inline. will push to labeling batch.

qa: when deploy completes i'll run the eval harness. command:
```bash
python infra/eval/run_suite.py --suite boundary-attribution:v2 --model atlas-int8 --out results/atlas-int8-boundary.json
```
will report hallucination/duplication per-type and latency impact.

harry: temporary fallback: runtime policy will route requests with context > 2048 tokens to fp16 pool until we confirm int8 mapping stable. config set at runtime, no customer-visible change.

zoe: good. also plan to add a small holdout in the golden set that stresses consecutive code fences and table rows. we'll mark those goldens as "sensitive-boundary" so they get higher weight in canaries.

labeler-bot: LB-1230 status: 6/50 assigned, 0/50 completed. reminders issued.

nina: after labeling review i'll cherry-pick 10 golds into the core golden repo and add a canary test. propose canary: atlas-int8 with chunk-sentinel -> 3% traffic for 12h in us-east. monitor: boundary-attribution:v2 alert > 2% regression.

harry: agree. i'll wire an alert in metrics: increase in "adjacent-frag-halluc" and kernel-pad-collision rate.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: atlas-int8 -> 3% us-east at 2026-07-02T04:00Z.

zoe: qbench on staging after deploy shows boundary hallucination down 85%, p95 latency +4%. posting permalink to dashboard.

nina: thanks. once labeling finishes and goldens merged we run canary and if green roll to 30% then full. i'll open a follow-up ticket to audit tokenizer remappings across quant kernels to avoid this class of regression.

harry: noted. also adding a note to the model-onboard checklist: always include adjacent-chunk micro-goldens for RAG models.

nina: closing loop for now, will update when LB-1230 completes and canary finishes. :white_check_mark:
